view.description: Use summary for healthy control/readiness; full retains complete frozen contracts for deliberate plan changes. Summary intentionally reports document_complete=false; read exact contracts with execution.inspect part=contract when needed.

input_schema.description: Read bounded workflow control facts. Prefer view=summary: exact versions, readiness/actions, dependencies, output refs and Human gates without repeating full task/contracts or Delivery schemas. Use view=full when the full contract is actually needed. With decision_ref, read immutable Human arguments in chunks.
